def build_fcgi_record(rec_type, request_id, content):
    """Build a FastCGI record"""
    version = 1
    content_len = len(content)
    padding_len = (8 - (content_len % 8)) % 8
    header = struct.pack('!BBHHBB',
        version,         # version
        rec_type,        # type
        request_id,      # requestId
        content_len,     # contentLength
        padding_len,     # paddingLength
        0                # reserved
    )
    return header + content + b'\x00' * padding_len

def build_begin_request(request_id):
    """Build FCGI_BEGIN_REQUEST"""
    role = struct.pack('!H', 1)  # FCGI_RESPONDER
    flags = b'\x00'  # keep connection alive
    reserved = b'\x00' * 5
    body = role + flags + reserved
    return build_fcgi_record(1, request_id, body)

def build_params(request_id, params_dict):
    """Build FCGI_PARAMS records"""
    # Build params body
    body = b''
    for key, value in params_dict.items():
        k = key.encode('utf-8')
        v = value.encode('utf-8')
        
        # Encode key length
        if len(k) < 128:
            body += struct.pack('B', len(k))
        else:
            body += struct.pack('!I', len(k) | 0x80000000)
        
        # Encode value length
        if len(v) < 128:
            body += struct.pack('B', len(v))
        else:
            body += struct.pack('!I', len(v) | 0x80000000)
        
        body += k + v
    
    return build_fcgi_record(4, request_id, body)

def build_empty_params(request_id):
    """Build empty FCGI_PARAMS to terminate params"""
    return build_fcgi_record(4, request_id, b'')
